# Overlay Library

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-overlay-docs.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

**286 overlays** in 18 categories: 108 data feeds, 67 imagery layers, 93 OpenStreetMap layers and 18 computed layers. Every one is keyless.

Open the **OVERLAYS** panel on the left rail (or press **L**; **Shift+L** opens the **STATS** tab). Search, filter by type, open a row for its description, source, legend and opacity, and click any feature on the globe for its details card.

- **Data feed** overlays come through the local `/api/overlay-feed/<id>` proxy, which only knows the allowlisted feeds in `server/providers/overlayFeeds/feeds.js`, caches every upstream and serves the last good copy when a source is down. Static reference datasets are cached on disk under `.gev-cache/overlay-feeds/` for a week.
- **OSM** overlays decode OpenFreeMap vector tiles (the same keyless OpenMapTiles source the app already uses) for the area around the view center, so they appear when you zoom in.
- **Imagery** overlays drape raster tiles on the globe; on Google Photorealistic 3D they drape on the photoreal tileset.
- **Computed** overlays are calculated in the browser (sun, moon, terminator, grids, range rings).

## STATS tab

Live numbers for the whole app, refreshed every second while the tab is open:

- headline tiles: overlays on, overlay features drawn, built-in layer objects, render rate, data loaded, errors;
- three-minute trends (render rate, overlay features, built-in layer objects, JavaScript heap where the browser reports it);
- objects per built-in data layer (flights, ships, satellites…) and features per active overlay;
- the library by category, and a **breakdown** of any active overlay (top groups and min/median/mean/max/total of its key value — e.g. nuclear capacity by country);
- sun and moon position, moon phase, and the NOAA planetary K-index for the last 7 days;
- camera, scene and network diagnostics, with **Export stats (JSON)**.
